required_validations: reread all five extracted binary/module members and the archive independently of the producer
verify the exact four-member transformation source-set identity while keeping nave.conf as metadata and rights support
verify exact archive member order, DEFLATE payload equality, CRC32, flags, compression method, DOS timestamp, external attributes, descriptors, and absence of unexplained ZIP gaps
reject malformed or truncated indexes, separators, compressed streams, block descriptors, pointers, UTF-8, or XML
verify every dictionary key and every physical payload is addressed exactly once
require exactly one terminal NUL per payload and reject missing, duplicated, nonzero, or embedded terminators
inventory every index record, pointer, CRLF delimiter, descriptor table, zlib stream, and exact zero allocation-padding carrier
verify every external dictionary key appears literally in readable TEI form/orth alongside the unnormalized payload entryFree n value
compare source XML and candidate node inventories by ordinal without correlated expected-TEI serialization
reject source-order, payload-text, element, attribute, reference, metadata, provenance, crosswalk, scope, manifest, unresolved-ledger, or attribution drift
validate content.tei.xml directly against the pinned TEI P5 XSD
validate manifest.json directly against the pinned candidate-package schema
validate source-accountability.json directly against the pinned source-accountability schema
